signal_parent_join_key.source_row_number: 1-based CSV data-row ordinal in the frozen signals.csv
signal_parent_join_key.join: paths.source_row_number = signals.csv 1-based data-row ordinal; parent_id is the same row identity

entry_timing.confirmation: 12Hutc bar close; confirmed_bjt converted to UTC milliseconds
entry_timing.entry: the 1H bar whose open time equals confirmation_ms, filled at its open
entry_timing.order: 12H close confirmation is processed before the next 1H open at the same UTC boundary
entry_timing.no_entry: if that exact 1H open is absent, retain an explicit no-entry row; never delay to a later hour

ema_exit.source: pure local recurrence identical to yoyo.monitor.cloud_signals.ema_points (avoids importing its FastAPI service module)
ema_exit.intrabar_level: price at which EMA20 and EMA50 would strictly reverse given the prior confirmed 12H EMA state
ema_exit.strict_cross: long low < level; short high > level; equality is not a flip
ema_exit.dynamic_update: refresh at each newly closed 12H boundary; no unfinished 12H close enters the EMA state

risk_and_targets.signal_stop: reference_stop from the original touched-side 1.618 default plan; absolute stop price retained
risk_and_targets.target_price: actual 1H-open entry plus side * tp_r * abs(actual entry - fixed stop)
risk_and_targets.control_stop: control entry adjusted to the matched parent's actual entry-to-reference-stop risk fraction
risk_and_targets.only_variable: fixed potential take-profit R; no TP/1R/2R/3R/4R/6R/10R

fill_policy.engine: VectorBT Portfolio.from_order_func flexible callback; independent columns, one base unit each
fill_policy.same_bar_priority: opening triggers are processed first; with no opening trigger, choose the nearer same-direction adverse barrier (EMA/stop) before TP; adverse plus opposite-side TP double touch is adverse-first and flagged
fill_policy.same_bar_ambiguity: flag only when no opening trigger occurred and adverse plus opposite-side target are both touched in the same OHLC bar
fill_policy.open_target: an open-through resting target fills at the target before later wicks are observable
fill_policy.stop_market_fill: bar open if already through at open, otherwise exact stop level
fill_policy.ema_market_fill: bar open if already strictly through at open, otherwise EMA cross level
fill_policy.tp_limit_fill: stated target level, maker fee, including an open-through
fill_policy.unexpected_gap: next observed 1H open markout before processing that bar's OHLC; taker fee and gap flag
fill_policy.series_tail: last observed 1H close, taker fee, exit_phase=close

control_matching.method: seeded random non-signal 12H confirmation, same symbol/NY week/side and EMA20-50 alignment
control_matching.atr_feature: previous confirmed 12H Wilder ATR14 / previous close, matching census definition
control_matching.sampling: one without-replacement control per symbol/week/side stratum where possible
control_matching.unmatched: explicit unmatched control path rows and per-symbol audit reason counts
